title: AMD action: uploadfile
description: WRITE STUB (AARON-REVIEWABLE-1 default: lives in patients): would upload a file (base64 contents) to a patient's chart. Streaming flagged (requires_streaming=true); handler enforces 1024kb cap. Hidden by WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED=False.

file_contents_b64.description: Base64-encoded file body. Hard cap 1024kb at handler level.

local_file_size_hint_kb.description: Optional size hint in kb for pre-flight cap check.
